title: No early feasibility/capability triage: projects discover missing generators/shippable weights/host limits only after design/architect
body: BI-0214: two-phase feasibility - build-host at ideation + destination at packaging.

rcca.root_cause: The pipeline assumed every required modality was buildable; there was no host probe and no machine-readable shipping-mode truth, so infeasibility surfaced late.
rcca.corrective: core/feasibility.py (host probe + assess_build/assess_destination + go/conditional/no-go, single writer), hardware-tiers config, wired at ideation (Phase 1) and packaging (Phase 2); reuses modality/generators/packs/target_advisor.
rcca.preventive: Phase 1 is mandatory at ideation and fails closed (unknown host => conditional, never silent go); phases are independent/idempotent; no duplication of generator/pack/cost truth.
rcca.fixed_where: core/feasibility.py; config/hardware-tiers.json; core/pipeline_executor.py (preflight); core/orchestrator/stage_runner.py (stage 9); scripts/pipeline.py; config/store-registry.json; test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_feasibility.py
